<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed" xml:id="ex5032023-05-2517-14-36">
     skabs bsdu ba ni de ci'i phyir zhe na de bzhin gshegs pa nas so || mtshan nyid dang de bkag pa ma grub pa de bzhin du'o || sgom pa la log rtog spang ba ni de ltar mtshan nyid shes pa'i don du slob pa nyid med na ched du bya ba thob pa'i don du de sgom pa mi 'thad do snyam na | lo tsA chen po'i zhal nas b+ha ba dang b+hi b+ha ba zhes pa'i sngon gyi <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsA chen po</rs>'i zhal nas b+ha ba dang b+hi b+ha ba zhes pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">sngon gyi lo tsA</rs>s dgag par ma go bar rnam par bsgyur ba de dgag pa ste mi sgom pa'am 'jig pa'o zhes sgom pa rnam par 'jig cing sgom pa dmigs su med pa nyid yul sgom par bstan pa ste | de lta nu'i log rtog bkag pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa la yid ches pa brtan pa kho na ting nge 'dzin 'di skye bas rgyu yin no || </seg></TEI>
